def area_maximization():
    # Function to calculate area given length l and width w
    def area(l):
        w = (400 - 2 * l) / np.pi  # Express w in terms of l
        if w < 0:  # If width becomes negative, return a very negative area (invalid)
            return -np.inf
        return - (l * w)  # We want to minimize the negative area

    # Calculate the optimal width using the found length
    optimal_l = result.x
    optimal_w = (400 - 2 * optimal_l) / np.pi
    max_area = optimal_l * optimal_w

    return max_area

     A = l \times w
     \]
